title: H.O.R.S.E.

tutorial.discipline: The discipline being played right now. It rotates H-O-R-S-E every few hands, and the rules change with it.
tutorial.seats: Each seat's stack and the cards it reveals. In the stud disciplines you also see everyone's face-up door cards.
tutorial.actions: The betting controls are the same in every discipline. Chips carry across disciplines, and the match ends as soon as a seat busts.

frontendHint.horseNextHand: The hand is settled — deal the next one
frontendHint.horseDisciplineChanged: The discipline just changed; check the rules before you act
frontendHint.horseOmahaUsesTwo: Omaha uses exactly two of your hole cards
frontendHint.horseRazzWantsLow: In Razz the lowest hand wins
frontendHint.horsePlayTheDiscipline: Play by the rules of the current discipline
